# HQTD Scientific — English Website

> Shanghai Hongqi Tengda Information Technology Co., Ltd. provides scientific services for universities, research institutes, hospitals, and industrial R&D teams.

English website: https://www.hongqitengda.com/en/
Chinese website: https://www.hongqitengda.com/
Contact: drwang@hongqitengda.cn

## Services
- [Project Catalog](https://www.hongqitengda.com/en/catalog.html): Search by English service or product names, scientific acronyms, keywords, and project IDs.
- [AI Projects](https://www.hongqitengda.com/en/board/ai-projects.html): Medical imaging, materials screening, predictive modeling, knowledge bases, and research agents.
- [Computational Simulation](https://www.hongqitengda.com/en/board/computational-simulation.html): CFD, DFT, molecular dynamics, quantum chemistry, and finite element analysis.
- [Characterization and Testing](https://www.hongqitengda.com/en/board/characterization-analysis.html): Microscopy, spectroscopy, elemental analysis, and material properties.
- [Laboratory Supplies](https://www.hongqitengda.com/en/board/research-supplies.html): Laboratory consumables, reagents, materials, and instruments.
- [Advanced Simulation](https://www.hongqitengda.com/en/high-end-simulation.html): Catalysis, membranes, interfaces, energy systems, and polymers.
- [Routine Water Testing](https://www.hongqitengda.com/en/water-testing.html)
- [Routine Soil Testing](https://www.hongqitengda.com/en/soil-testing.html)
- [Emerging Contaminants](https://www.hongqitengda.com/en/emerging-contaminants.html)
